utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard this month’s pick is a real page-turner—everyone’s talking about it. Did you get a copy yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet—are we sure that’s the one everyone picked?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the one I heard floating around the group—though I’d check the message thread just to be sure. If you want, I can ask around too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention the book club plans to everyone and see who can make it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I probably would’ve missed it anyway. Let me know if there’s anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll let you know. Just bring your usual good questions if you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time and where’s the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s at 7 on Thursday at the community center by the park.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll be there at 7 on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I’ve been meaning to stop by sometime—what are you reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re reading a mystery this month—pretty cozy, but it’s got a good twist. If you stop by, I can lend you my extra copy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds lovely—I'd be happy to borrow your extra copy if I can make it by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds nice — what day is the book club meeting, so I can work around the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s on Thursday evening, around 7 — I can send you the exact details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please send the exact details — that should work much better for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—what’s the plan for the book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit foggy, but I think we were going to pick a new book and chat about it over tea. I can double-check the details and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine—please double-check and let me know the details. I like having the plan settled ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia, I’m glad I caught you — the book club’s meeting this week, and you should come! It’s a lovely little group, and I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — I’d like to come, but could you send the time and address so I can make sure I can get there?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the time and address right away, and I’d love to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve mostly just heard little bits about the book club from others—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re meeting Thursday evening at the community room, and this month’s pick is a really good mystery. If you want, I can save you a spot and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would be great, thanks—I’d love a spot and the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the book club details first? I want to make sure I’ve got them right before I say anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can help with that. What details do you want to double-check about the book club?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — what book are we reading, and when and where does the book club meet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve been meaning to join, but I’m keeping things low-key right now. What book are you all reading?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: We’re reading "The Night Circus" this month — I’m usually the one slipping in late, but you’d still be welcome if you want.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds lovely, thank you. I may just listen in this time and see how I feel.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if the book club needs anything handy, I’ve got tools and can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you know what book we’re reading next?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure yet, Mina, but I can check with the group and let you know. If you need anything for the meetup, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that—where’s the book club meeting this time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—it's at the community center again, same room as last time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, the community center in the same room as last time. I’ll remember that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if the book club needs anything. What are you folks working on?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. We’re still figuring out the next book and a good time to meet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help with either — if you want, I can bring over a few good book ideas or help nail down a meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’d like to know the time and where we’re meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — I’ll confirm the time and place first, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me — just let me know once you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I was just thinking the book club could be a fun way to get everyone chatting. Have you picked what we’re reading next?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet, but I’m happy to bring a few suggestions to our next meetup and we can pick one together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect — I’d love to hear your suggestions and choose together. We can make it a really good pick for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring extra snacks and paper if we need them for book club.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, that’d be great — I’ll probably be a little late as usual, but I’ll bring my notes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — I’ll set the snacks and paper aside for you. See you when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard this month’s pick is a real page-turner, and there’s supposed to be tea and pastries too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds lovely — I’ll check our school schedule and see if I can make it. Tea, pastries, and a good book are hard to pass up!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Fantastic — if you can come, I’ll save you a seat by the window. It should be a cozy one this month!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the book club. What’s the next book on the list?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m checking the list now, Bo, and I’ll let you know the next pick right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa—just text me when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — can you help pick the next book and send a quick reminder to everyone?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll help pick the next book and send a quick reminder to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Nell, you should come to book club this week — I think you’d really enjoy it. It’s a friendly group, and I’m happy to save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds lovely — I’d like that a lot. Thanks for saving me a spot; I’ll come by this week.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful — I’m glad you’re coming! We meet Thursday evening at my place, and I’ll make sure there’s a seat for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the book club meets over at the community center on Maple, usually in the little room by the library desk.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right to me. I’ll plan on Maple, by the library desk, unless we hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yep, that’s the spot I’d go with too. I’ll keep an ear out in case they move it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the book club pick a title yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I want to double-check the suggestions before we decide. Did you have a title in mind?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I was leaning toward "The Midnight Library" since it’s easy to discuss, but I’m open to other picks too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club picked a new novel for next week. Sounds like everyone’s got opinions already!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club! I’m probably behind on the new pick already, but I’ll catch up before next week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, there’s still time—if you want, I can tell you the title when I’m back from errands.
